I need complete BibTeX entries for these 5 papers. Use WebSearch to find each one, then return the complete BibTeX for all 5.

1. **Cinelli & Hazlett (2020)** "Making Sense of Sensitivity: Extending Omitted Variable Bias" — published in JRSS-B (Journal of the Royal Statistical Society Series B)
2. **Gilardi et al. (2023)** "ChatGPT Outperforms Crowd-Workers for Text-Annotation Tasks" — published in PNAS
3. **Ziems et al. (2024)** "Can Large Language Models Transform Computational Social Science?" — published in Computational Linguistics
4. **Bound, Brown & Mathiowetz (2001)** — Chapter 59 in Handbook of Econometrics, about measurement error in survey data
5. **Richardson & Gilks (1993)** — need to find exact title and venue. This is about Bayesian measurement error models. Search for "Richardson Gilks 1993 measurement error Bayesian"

For each, return a complete BibTeX entry with: author, title, journal/booktitle, year, volume, number, pages, doi (if available). Use consistent formatting. Return ONLY the 5 BibTeX entries, nothing else.
I'll search for all 5 papers in parallel.
